decisions.statement: A rule that did not match the transaction is refused.
A reservation names no category to set and is refused.
An ambiguity is refused rather than guessed between.
Both legs of a paired decision are categorized rather than only the subject.
The rule that decided is recorded as the rule's own name.
A rule's note is written only onto the subject and only where no note stands.

definition: one rule's decision written onto the transaction it decided
